page.layout: One page of text. Above: running title-heading "I. DRVSIVS" and the greeting "Lectori S. dico." Below them: an italic preface paragraph across the full width. Then two columns of alphabetical name entries (left and right), with a catchword at the bottom right. No margin notes, page number or running head.

main_text.head: I. DRVSIVS

p.i: Scire te volo, Lector, nomina Ebraica, quae in hoc libro, pleraque omnia corrupta esse. Quod accidit incuria, ne dicam inscitia[?], describentium: tum etiam quia Sulpitius secutus fuit editionem Graecam vulgatam, ubi pariter haec nomina corrupta sunt. Ea nunc ordine alphabetico digesta & e regione, ad priscam consuetudinem, quam a Hieronymo didicimus, emendata, in medium conferimus, vacaturas alioqui paginas, ex consilio typographi, hoc modo explicantes. Habe & boni consule.

main_text.p: Abraham recte quidem dicitur, sed in hoc libro aliquoties occurrit pro Abram. Quod antiquum huius patriarchae nomen, qui postea unius litterae additione Abraham dictus fuit.
main_text.l: Achas. Achaz. Sed A-chas se tuetur consuetudine Graeca, quam notavi Observat. lib. 9. cap. 9. Sic Ioachas.

page.notes: The printed "c" marks before some Hebrew forms (e.g. "c/Ahod", "c/Amalec") appear as a letter c with a slanted stroke; they are transcribed as "c/" and may be a reference or correction sign. "infcitia" is printed with a long-s ligature and is rendered "inscitia[?]". Some words in the right column (Achas continuation, "mendum chalcographi") are small and partly faded. The catchword "Baltha-" is printed at the bottom right and is also the start of the next entry.
